displayPattern: Front-load washer display shows LOC or LC
meaning: Control Lock is on. It is a lockout of the controls, not a mechanical fault.
diySteps: Touch the Control Lock button. On older models, use the button your owner's manual names for control lock
Some models need that button pressed and held
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If LOC or LC will not clear after the Control Lock press your model uses, contact Whirlpool. It is not the door-lock code F5 E2.
sourceTitle: Error Codes in Front Load Washers (Whirlpool Product Help)
